descriptions.High-Value Regulars: Strong repeat purchasing and spending with a slightly longer purchase gap than the freshest Champions profile.
descriptions.Valuable Customers at Risk: Meaningful rolling-window purchasing value with a longer purchase gap; this does not establish a previous Loyalists assignment.
descriptions.Mid-Tier Occasionals: Recent purchasing with moderate value and less frequent ordering than the strongest repeat-purchase profiles.
descriptions.Occasional Buyers at Risk: Infrequent purchasing with a substantial purchase gap.
descriptions.Light Buyers: Relatively low-frequency, lower-spending customers who purchased recently; growth is not assumed.
descriptions.Light Buyers at Risk: A light purchasing profile with a longer purchase gap.
descriptions.Hibernating / Lost: Predominantly customers without purchases for more than 90 days; individuals can differ from the weighted profile.
